scentSummary: Feu is a fruity-sweet fragrance with prominent fresh and citrus accords. Top notes feature mango, ginger, lemon, and rhubarb; the heart contains jasmine, pink pepper, praliné, and violet; the base develops ambergris, cedarwood, moss, and tonka bean for warmth and depth.
